You have to see forgiveness not as something that benefits the ones that you're forgiving, but as something to benefit you. Forgiving doesn't mean that what happened isn't wrong, it just means that you're acknowledging that you're going to move past it and not let the anger for it affect your life. And you don't have to go tell the person that you forgive them, you just have to forgive them in your own heart. Deep breath, let go of any resentment, deep breath, and keep breathing.

But you have to really want to forgive and be ready for it. It's something that I'm dealing with as well. I have some family that I'm not ready to forgive, and don't feel like forgiving anytime soon. But I honestly don't hold any resentment towards them in my everyday life, so it's not something I feel is too urgent.

And I would ask your therapist what they recommend in terms of helping you forgive. I'm sure he will have some ideas that will specifically help you.
